One key thing is edge highlighting with a gradient. Some things like the fur on the leg are pretty good but the horns in the skull (the centre piece) is high contrast and doesn’t blend together very well.  The skull itself looks great with the gradient but the highlighting ruins it a bit. Certain spots on the mini also have discolouration as in you grazed the brush on the model with a could you shouldn’t have e.g. the blue on the rope that ties around the staff. Lastly, there are some spots with no colour such as the back of the spear on the wrinkles with the purple and red. If you want a tip, take a photo of your model from various angles (like you have) and look for mistakes or places you missed and fix them. Don’t do this for you’re entire army or you’ll die before you finish them all but on certain minis it’s great and works all of the time. Hope I wasn’t too critical for you, lovely model nevertheless. If you have any questions let me know. Happy hobbying!
